title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer of 4.5 H.P.

title: Correct Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive and apply the equation for resistance force F = mV^2/(60V_0).

title: Horsepower Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the horsepower using P' = F'V'.

title: Unit Conversion
description: Optional Criteria: The student should demonstrate proper unit conversions throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in the equations derived for velocity and force.

title: Mass Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly relate the weight of the car to its mass in calculations.

title: Resistance Understanding
description: Optional Criteria: The student should explain the physical meaning of the resistance force acting on the car.

title: Final Units
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that the final answer is expressed in the correct units of horsepower.
